controls.fundamental_rule: No tuning on known respondent data; only a new frozen source+algorithm+questionnaire+baseline+matched-decoy bundle can be used for untouched human testing.
controls.multiple_testing: Report all source-supported outcomes, every attempted rule and dependent-correlation groups; no best-story selection.
controls.source_versioning: Original verse / translation / commentary / variant distinguished. B18 reduction calculators remain competing pure arithmetic choices.
controls.high_stakes: No clinical, legal, financial or relationship safety advice based on astrology.

scope_limit: Diagnostic classification, not a commitment to add all optional questionnaire questions. The current live survey was not examined or changed.
